# CARA-Cache repository rules

## Read and orient

Read [EXPERIMENT_REPORT.md](EXPERIMENT_REPORT.md), [current state](research/02_CURRENT_STATE.md), [next actions](research/09_NEXT_ACTIONS.md), and [handoff](memory/handoffs/LATEST.md). Use the source receipts linked by current state; generated documentation is a timestamped snapshot, not a runtime lock. Historical instructions and completed authorizations remain in [the archive](docs/archive/README.md).

## Execution and evidence

- This repository is WorldCache/CARA-only. OMR work belongs to the separate `omr-experiments` repository. Keep legacy package/project/stage identifiers for compatibility.
- Prepare every new card for both registered hosts: four-card RTX 6000 Ada (SM89), preferred by default, and two-card RTX A6000 (SM86). Share the frozen scientific manifest; bind host-specific runtime/resources, affected-path production CPU evidence and complete quotes. At dispatch prefer an admissible idle four-card GPU, otherwise use an admissible idle two-card GPU within the existing authorization and cap. Recover any existing intent on either host first; one card must never launch on both. Use one central 226 GPUh ledger and one budget envelope, preserve the old 16.5 GPUh uncertainty reserve, and settle external-host costs back to that ledger. Follow the dual-host requirements in [execution workflow](docs/EXECUTION_MODES.md). This standing preference grants no extra GPU execution, replay or budget. CAL66 has completed and settled its A6000 launch; neither the old Ada instance nor the completed A6000 card may relaunch. The user explicitly authorized one complete DEV128 on two-card A6000 on 2026-10-26: 128 paths, 12 GPUh, cumulative 226 GPUh and final deployment budget unchanged. It has launched; follow the unique receipt in current state, never replay or dispatch on the other host. Never touch other users' processes, drivers or jobs. Connection secrets stay outside Git.
- Preserve each registered card's exact inputs, methods, repeats, denominators, scope and whole-cost budget. A completed authorization is not permission to replay a card. The completed whole1624 asset card's 12 GPUh authorization does not authorize a replay; the new price refresh has its own complete scope/quote and requires its own production CPU and admission.
- Track an active run by its launch receipt, source hash, stage, PID/start ticks, container and GPU UUID. Do not change its source/config. UNKNOWN requires recovering the original handle before any dispatch. Keep original failures and actual costs.
- Before any new dispatch, verify actual production CPU/source/assets/import/runtime, fresh UUID/VRAM/compute apps, owner lock, ledger, full quote, disk and memory. One expensive owned job at a time; Git synchronization is not a distributed execution lock. Long runs require actual-start-based halfway and terminal checks, without duplicate submissions or checks.
- For future GPU cards, require actual single-GPU exclusivity as requested on 2026-10-23: administrator scheduling/device isolation or supported EXCLUSIVE_PROCESS plus exact sole-runner context verification. A project flock is insufficient. Follow [price/exclusivity continuation](plans/cara_policy_generator_20261020/PRICE_HISTORY_NATIVE_CONTINUATION_R1_20261023.md) and [full price refresh](plans/cara_policy_generator_20261020/FULL1624_PRICE_REFRESH_R1_20261023.md); never evict others or change a busy card's mode. Preserve the completed 1624 originals; its original generator_input_ready flag cannot clear the independent contention/price trust gate.
- Keep pinned upstream unmodified. Identify and version runtime adaptations separately; share them between comparison paths where appropriate.
- True anchors are full computations in the same request, CFG branch and model/expert. Shadow truth never updates deployed state. Reset on request or model/condition changes; fail safe on nonfinite values or insufficient anchors.
- CPU tests demonstrate implementation, not video quality or speed. Separate local MSE, endpoint fidelity, automatic quality, clean latency and billed GPUh. Preserve refusal/failure denominators and matched cohorts. Do not count reused artifacts as new independent samples.
- Keep CAL/SELECT/DEV/TEST roles and frozen selection rules. Do not fit thresholds to BANK24 DEV or tune from partial running outputs. For new work follow the user-authorized 2026-10-25 exploration/confirmation contract in plans/cara_policy_generator_20261020/EXPLORATION_CONFIRMATION_CONTRACT_R1_20261025.md and the newer CAL66 design in plans/cara_policy_generator_20261020/CAL66_DESIGN_AND_DECISION_CONTRACT_R1_20261025.md. CAL106 is superseded before GPU execution; retain its original accepted CPU evidence, and validate the CAL66 changes separately. Preserve historical PG-P1→P2→P3→P4 receipts and each registered card's scope/cost/admission. The user explicitly authorized one complete CAL66 launch on 2026-10-25: 66 paths, 8 GPUh per-card limit, cumulative 226 GPUh and final deployment budget unchanged. Fresh exclusive admission and existing-handle recovery remain mandatory; this does not authorize a replay.

- Execution workflow and documentation cadence follow [docs/EXECUTION_MODES.md](docs/EXECUTION_MODES.md) (EXPLORE/CONFIRM modes, card specs in `cards/`, question queue in [plans/QUESTION_QUEUE.md](plans/QUESTION_QUEUE.md)). It changes process only; the safety and evidence rules above and every registered card's scope, budget and authorization take precedence, and it grants no new GPU authority. Explicit chat authorization remains valid; no additional signature is required. Reuse unchanged accepted components and verify affected paths.

## Documentation and synchronization

- `docs/project_status.json` owns the current evidence snapshot and receipt pointers. `paper/experiment_master_table.json` owns the scientific rows and their evidence references. `paper/internal_to_paper_mapping.json` owns names and versioned identities. Update these inputs and the relevant `docs/templates/` file, then run `python3 docs/tools/render_repository_docs.py` and `--check`.
- Do not prepend daily logs to generated README/current state/overview/table/handoff/AGENTS. Add a numbered research note and a uniquely named machine receipt for a meaningful event, then regenerate all navigation together. Retain old records, aliases, complete evidence references and archived hashes.
- Commit and synchronize meaningful code/config/result changes to private `kuangda-source/CARA-cache` before reporting completion. Keep code, plans, tests, manifests, summaries and small receipts in Git. Never commit credentials, private transport logs, weights, bulk tensors or videos; record their paths/hashes instead.
- Preserve unrelated changes and remote parent history; no force push. When reconciling Git, choose evidence by actual receipt identity/time rather than combining incompatible statuses. A connector atomic commit is acceptable if local Git access fails; verify the resulting commit/tree.

For routine documentation work, use saved receipts and local checks; do not poll, restart or re-stage a running experiment merely to refresh prose.
